title: Kinematics of molecular gas in star-forming galaxies with large-scale ionized outflows
question: Explore the diversity of molecular gas kinematic structures across edge-on galaxies hosting large-scale ionised outflows and test whether a single mechanism like bar instabilities explains central gas and SFR concentrations.

what.value: PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) sample degraded to ~1 kpc resolution to create a control distribution of flux asymmetry.

evidence.quote: To compare the flux asymmetry we observe in our objects to a control sample, we use the PHANGS-ALMA (cite: leroy21) sample to create a distribution of flux asymmetry.
We degrade the PHANGS-ALMA CO(2) resolution to be comparable to our physical resolution of $\rm\approx 1~kpc$ and perform the same procedure summarised by Equation [\[eq: flux\]](#eq: flux).

what.value: Effective radius (r_e) values from the GAMA DR3 catalogue.

evidence.quote: For these PVDs we use slit width equal to the effective radius ($r_e$) of the objects (where we use $r_e$ values from the GAMA DR3 catalogue), so that the slit extends half an $r_e$ either side of the kinematic centre along the major axis.

what.value: g-band and r-band magnitudes from SDSS DR16.

evidence.quote: where $g$ and $r$ are the g-band and r-band magnitudes for our objects from SDSS DR16 (cite: ahumada20), which using SDSS conversions in Equation [\[eq: bv\]](#eq: bv), we transform into $B-V$ colours.
We attempt this by extracting Multi-Gaussian Expansion (MGE) models (cite: emsellem94) using r-band photometry from HSC (cite: aihara19).

recipe.goal: Reduce ALMA data and extract basic data products
recipe.method: Reduce ALMA data with standard CASA pipeline subroutines and extract total CO(1-0) emission, moment maps, and PVDs as in H21.
assumptions: LambdaCDM cosmology with H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m0 = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7, Chabrier (2003) IMF

recipe.goal: 3D kinematic modelling of CO(1-0) data cubes
recipe.method: Fit simulated 3D interferometric data cubes to ALMA CO(1-0) cubes using multiple candidate surface brightness profiles combined with an arctangent velocity curve.
key_parameters: Position angle, RA centre, Dec centre, velocity centre, inclination, total flux, velocity dispersion, surface brightness parameters, arctan velocity parameters (V_max, R_turn); total flux fixed for GAMA228432, GAMA238125, and GAMA574200.
assumptions: Gas is dynamically cold and relaxed, symmetric about spatial and spectral kinematic centres, following an arctangent rotation curve.

recipe.goal: Derive stellar circular velocity curves via Multi-Gaussian Expansion (MGE)
recipe.method: Mask dust regions by eye in HSC r-band images, fit MGE surface brightness models, circularise components for edge-on deprojection, and compute circular velocity curves with upper/lower limits by including/excluding unresolved central components.
assumptions: Constant mass-to-light ratio (M/L) from Bell & de Jong (2001) colour calibration using SDSS DR16 g and r magnitudes (log M/L = -0.66 + 1.222(B-V) +/- 0.1 dex); dust acts as a foreground screen.

recipe.goal: Extract and compare major- and minor-axis PVDs and compute V/sigma
recipe.method: Rotate ALMA cubes and 2D SAMI maps by KinMS position angle and centre on kinematic centre; extract major-axis PVDs (2 kpc slit) and minor-axis PVDs (r_e slit), compute normalised data-model residuals, and calculate V/sigma from KinMS parameters.
key_parameters: Major axis slit width = 2 kpc; minor axis slit width = r_e

recipe.goal: Quantify velocity and flux asymmetries in major-axis PVDs
recipe.method: For velocity asymmetry, binarise major-axis PVDs (1 where gas is present, 0 otherwise), rotate by 180 deg, and subtract from unrotated binary PVD. For flux asymmetry, compute sum(|PVD - PVD_rot|)/(2*sum(PVD)) and compare with PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) degraded to ~1 kpc resolution.
key_parameters: 180 deg rotation; degraded PHANGS-ALMA resolution ~ 1 kpc

recipe.method: Re-model GAMA593680 in KinMS_fitter by adding a bi-symmetric radial bar-flow component (radial_barflow) to the two-Gaussian surface brightness profile and arctan rotation curve.
key_parameters: 4 additional parameters: bar radius (R_bar), bar phase (phi_bar), radial velocity (V_r), transverse velocity (V_t)
assumptions: Non-axisymmetric bi-symmetric bar-flow from galaxy centre to R_bar with fixed radial and transverse velocities.

answer_key.quantity: GAMA593680 radial bar-flow transverse velocity V_t
GAMA593680 radial bar-flow radial velocity V_r
GAMA593680 radial bar-flow bar radius R_bar
GAMA593680 radial bar-flow bar phase Phi_bar

score_reason: Public data and open-source fitting tools (KinMS, KinMS_fitter, GAStimator, MgeFit, JamPy) with full tables of initial guesses, priors, and best-fit parameters in Appendix B, though raw cube imaging parameters are deferred to H21 and HSC dust masks are manual.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data cubes and open-source KinMS_fitter/GAStimator software with explicitly tabulated priors, initial guesses, and best-fit kinematic parameters for all seven galaxies provide a clear numeric benchmark.
